verse.verse_1: When the earth is shaken with its mighty shaking,
verse.verse_2: and when the earth brings forth its burdens
verse.verse_3: and the human asks: "What is the matter with it?"
verse.verse_4: On that Day it shall proclaim its news,
verse.verse_5: for your Lord will have revealed to it.
verse.verse_6: On that Day mankind shall issue in scatterings to see their deeds.
verse.verse_7: Whosoever has done an atom's weight of good shall see it,
verse.verse_8: and whosoever has done an atom's weight of evil shall see it.
